overall_goal: Retrieve, weigh, and log ingredients, tidy the workspace, and clean utensils

goals.description: Retrieve a glass jug from the drawer
goals.rationale: The person opens drawers to find and take out a glass jug, then closes the drawers.

goals.description: Retrieve a packet of mushrooms from the cupboard
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboard, selects a packet of mushrooms, and brings it over to the workspace.

goals.description: Weigh the dried mushrooms and log the weight
goals.rationale: The person transfers the mushrooms into a jug on the scale, turns it on, and writes down the measurement.

goals.description: Prepare the scale and begin transferring chopped onion into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person tares the scale with a bowl and starts scooping chopped onion from the board into the bowl.

goals.description: Finish transferring the chopped onion, remove skins, and log the weight
goals.rationale: The person removes unwanted onion skins, scoops the remaining onion into the bowl, and writes down the final weight.

goals.description: Pour water from the kettle and handle the fork
goals.rationale: The person uses the kettle to pour water into the jug, then taps and puts down a fork.

goals.description: Tidy the workspace by moving packaging and bowls
goals.rationale: The person pushes plastic packaging out of the way and moves a bowl of chopped ingredients.

goals.description: Retrieve minced garlic from the fridge
goals.rationale: The person opens the fridge, searches through the shelves and drawers, and takes out a jar of minced garlic.

goals.description: Tare the digital scales and log the weight of the garlic
goals.rationale: The person presses the buttons on the scale to zero it out, then writes down the measurement on paper.

goals.description: Tidy the workspace by moving ingredients and utensils out of the way
goals.rationale: The person moves the garlic jar, rolls up discarded cling film, and shifts a bowl, knife, and lid to clear space.

goals.description: Inspect mushrooms, discard them, and weigh the empty tray
goals.rationale: The person checks the mushrooms, decides they are bad, throws them and onion skins into the food waste bin, and then weighs the empty cardboard tray.

goals.description: Rinse the colander and baking tray in the sink
goals.rationale: The person washes the colander under the tap, drains a soaking baking tray, rinses their hands, and moves the clean colander to the chopping board.
